description: Enforces industry-standard formatting conventions for every output type, even when not explicitly requested. Activates on any request to produce a song, lyric sheet, script, screenplay, email, letter, memo, legal document, resume, recipe, chord chart, lead sheet, tablature, lesson plan, press release, invoice, brief, pitch deck outline, interview transcript, meeting minutes, style guide, or any other structured deliverable with a known professional format. Also triggers on: format this correctly, fix the formatting, proper format, industry standard, how should this look, lyric sheet, song structure, script format, screenplay format, business letter, cover letter, formal memo, legal brief, or any output where implicit format conventions exist.
